quests.conceptTitle: Timeline Mapping: Past Perfect Progressive Tense
quests.sentence: The server had been running smoothly for months before it suddenly crashed during the product launch.
quests.ruleExplanation: Had been running is the past perfect progressive form, emphasizing a long continuing state before a disruptive past event.
quests.nativeTip: This measures how long the server had been working before the crash, an earlier stretch of time.
quests.example: The server had been running smoothly for months before it suddenly crashed during the product launch.

quests.sentence: The crash wiped out three hours of unsaved work.
quests.ruleExplanation: Wiped out is the simple past form, describing the central event of the narrative.
quests.nativeTip: This is the main event of the story, told as a single completed action.
quests.example: The crash wiped out three hours of unsaved work.

quests.sentence: By the time IT restored the backup, the whole team had missed the launch deadline.
quests.ruleExplanation: Had missed is the past perfect form, describing a consequence that occurred before another later past event.
quests.nativeTip: The deadline was already missed before the restoration finished, an earlier consequence.
quests.example: By the time IT restored the backup, the whole team had missed the launch deadline.

quests.conceptTitle: Timeline Mapping: Past Perfect Progressive Tense
quests.sentence: We had been driving for six hours when the check-engine light came on.
quests.ruleExplanation: Had been driving is the past perfect progressive form, emphasizing duration before an interrupting past event.
quests.nativeTip: This stresses how long the driving had continued before the warning appeared.
quests.example: We had been driving for six hours when the check-engine light came on.

quests.sentence: We pulled over at the next exit to call for help.
quests.ruleExplanation: Pulled over is the simple past form, describing the next action in a straightforward sequence.
quests.nativeTip: This is the next clear step in the story, told as a simple sequence.
quests.example: We pulled over at the next exit to call for help.

quests.sentence: By the time the tow truck arrived, we'd already missed our hotel check-in window.
quests.ruleExplanation: Had missed (shortened to 'd missed) is the past perfect form, describing a consequence complete before another past event.
quests.nativeTip: This consequence was already true before the tow truck showed up, an earlier point.
quests.example: By the time the tow truck arrived, we'd already missed our hotel check-in window.

quests.sentence: She had researched the company thoroughly before walking into the interview room.
quests.ruleExplanation: Had researched is the past perfect form, describing preparation completed before a later past event.
quests.nativeTip: The research was finished before she even entered the room, an earlier past action.
quests.example: She had researched the company thoroughly before walking into the interview room.

quests.sentence: The interviewer asked several follow-up questions about her leadership style.
quests.ruleExplanation: Asked is the simple past form, describing the central action of the narrative.
quests.nativeTip: This is the main event of the interview, told as a single completed action.
quests.example: The interviewer asked several follow-up questions about her leadership style.

quests.sentence: While she was answering the final question, her phone buzzed loudly in her bag.
quests.ruleExplanation: Was answering is the past progressive form, describing the ongoing background action interrupted by the phone.
quests.nativeTip: One action was already underway when the sudden interruption happened.
quests.example: While she was answering the final question, her phone buzzed loudly in her bag.

quests.conceptTitle: Timeline Mapping: Past Perfect Progressive Tense
quests.sentence: The students had been waiting outside the classroom for ten minutes when the substitute finally showed up.
quests.ruleExplanation: Had been waiting is the past perfect progressive form, emphasizing a duration leading up to a later past event.
quests.nativeTip: This measures how long the waiting had continued before the substitute arrived.
quests.example: The students had been waiting outside the classroom for ten minutes when the substitute finally showed up.

quests.sentence: The substitute apologized and quickly unlocked the door.
quests.ruleExplanation: Apologized is the simple past form, describing the next action in a clear sequence.
quests.nativeTip: This is the next straightforward step in the story.
quests.example: The substitute apologized and quickly unlocked the door.

quests.sentence: By lunchtime, the class had already covered two full chapters.
quests.ruleExplanation: Had covered is the past perfect form, describing progress finished before a later past reference point.
quests.nativeTip: This achievement was complete before another later point in the day.
quests.example: By lunchtime, the class had already covered two full chapters.

quests.conceptTitle: Timeline Mapping: Past Perfect Progressive Tense
quests.sentence: By the time the guests arrived, my mother had been cooking since sunrise.
quests.ruleExplanation: Had been cooking is the past perfect progressive form, emphasizing a long duration leading up to a later past event.
quests.nativeTip: This stresses how long she had already been cooking before the guests showed up.
quests.example: By the time the guests arrived, my mother had been cooking since sunrise.

quests.sentence: Everyone gathered around the table as soon as the food was ready.
quests.ruleExplanation: Gathered is the simple past form, describing the central event of the story.
quests.nativeTip: This is the main event, told as a simple completed action.
quests.example: Everyone gathered around the table as soon as the food was ready.

quests.sentence: My uncle told the same story he tells at every family gathering.
quests.ruleExplanation: Tells is the simple present form, describing a general habit about my uncle, used inside an otherwise past-tense story.
quests.nativeTip: The second half describes a general, ongoing truth about him, not something limited to that one day.
quests.example: My uncle told the same story he tells at every family gathering.

quests.sentence: The customer had already complained to two other representatives before reaching me.
quests.ruleExplanation: Had complained is the past perfect form, describing earlier events that occurred before a later past moment.
quests.nativeTip: These complaints happened before the customer got to me, an earlier point in the sequence.
quests.example: The customer had already complained to two other representatives before reaching me.

quests.sentence: I apologized and offered a replacement immediately.
quests.ruleExplanation: Apologized is the simple past form, describing the central response in the narrative.
quests.nativeTip: This is the main action taken in response, told as a simple sequence.
quests.example: I apologized and offered a replacement immediately.

quests.sentence: While I was processing the refund, the system unexpectedly logged me out.
quests.ruleExplanation: Was processing is the past progressive form, describing the ongoing action interrupted by the system error.
quests.nativeTip: One action was in progress when the sudden technical issue interrupted it.
quests.example: While I was processing the refund, the system unexpectedly logged me out.

quests.conceptTitle: Timeline Mapping: Past Perfect Progressive Tense
quests.sentence: The app had been crashing intermittently for weeks before the developers finally found the cause.
quests.ruleExplanation: Had been crashing is the past perfect progressive form, emphasizing a recurring problem over time before a resolution.
quests.nativeTip: This stresses how long the problem had continued before it was solved.
quests.example: The app had been crashing intermittently for weeks before the developers finally found the cause.

quests.sentence: They traced the bug to a single line of outdated code.
quests.ruleExplanation: Traced is the simple past form, describing the main resolving event of the story.
quests.nativeTip: This is the key discovery, told as a single completed action.
quests.example: They traced the bug to a single line of outdated code.

quests.sentence: By the next release, the team will have rewritten that entire module.
quests.ruleExplanation: Will have rewritten is the future perfect form, describing a task expected to be finished by a future point.
quests.nativeTip: The next release is a future point by which this task will be complete.
quests.example: By the next release, the team will have rewritten that entire module.

quests.conceptTitle: Timeline Mapping: Past Perfect Progressive Tense
quests.sentence: I'd been sitting in the waiting room for almost an hour when they finally called my name.
quests.ruleExplanation: Had been sitting (shortened to 'd been sitting) is the past perfect progressive form, emphasizing duration before a later past event.
quests.nativeTip: This measures the length of the wait leading up to being called.
quests.example: I'd been sitting in the waiting room for almost an hour when they finally called my name.

quests.sentence: The doctor apologized for the delay and explained there'd been an emergency.
quests.ruleExplanation: Apologized is the simple past form, describing the central action taken by the doctor.
quests.nativeTip: This is the main reported action, the doctor's response, told as a single completed event.
quests.example: The doctor apologized for the delay and explained there'd been an emergency.

quests.sentence: By the time I left, I'd forgotten most of what she'd told me.
quests.ruleExplanation: Had forgotten (shortened to 'd forgotten) is the past perfect form, describing a state reached before another later past point.
quests.nativeTip: The forgetting happened by a later point, and it followed something explained even earlier.
quests.example: By the time I left, I'd forgotten most of what she'd told me.

quests.conceptTitle: Timeline Mapping: Past Perfect Progressive Tense
quests.sentence: The design team had been revising the prototype for weeks when leadership abruptly changed the requirements.
quests.ruleExplanation: Had been revising is the past perfect progressive form, emphasizing continuing work interrupted by a later past event.
quests.nativeTip: This stresses the length of ongoing work before the sudden change.
quests.example: The design team had been revising the prototype for weeks when leadership abruptly changed the requirements.

quests.sentence: Everyone in the room groaned when they heard the news.
quests.ruleExplanation: Groaned is the simple past form, describing a reaction that followed directly after another event.
quests.nativeTip: This is the immediate reaction, told as a simple sequential event.
quests.example: Everyone in the room groaned when they heard the news.

quests.sentence: By the next sprint review, the team will have adapted the entire design to the new specifications.
quests.ruleExplanation: Will have adapted is the future perfect form, describing a task expected to be finished by a future point.
quests.nativeTip: The next review is a future point by which this adaptation will be complete.
quests.example: By the next sprint review, the team will have adapted the entire design to the new specifications.

quests.conceptTitle: Timeline Mapping: Past Perfect Progressive Tense
quests.sentence: The warehouse had been operating at full capacity for years before the new regulations forced major changes.
quests.ruleExplanation: Had been operating is the past perfect progressive form, emphasizing a long-continuing state before a later past change.
quests.nativeTip: This stresses a long-running situation before the disruption caused by new rules.
quests.example: The warehouse had been operating at full capacity for years before the new regulations forced major changes.

quests.sentence: Managers scrambled to redesign the entire safety protocol within a single month.
quests.ruleExplanation: Scrambled is the simple past form, describing the central action taken in response to the new regulations.
quests.nativeTip: This is the main response to the situation, told as a completed action.
quests.example: Managers scrambled to redesign the entire safety protocol within a single month.

quests.sentence: By the time inspectors returned, the warehouse had implemented every required change.
quests.ruleExplanation: Had implemented is the past perfect form, describing changes completed before a later past event.
quests.nativeTip: All the changes were finished before the inspectors came back, an earlier point in the story.
quests.example: By the time inspectors returned, the warehouse had implemented every required change.
